operator_visible_outcome: The complete governed URL-reference path emits bounded phase measurements without changing its authority, timeout, protocol or evidence semantics

inputs.validation: Strict versioned workload cases selected from the governed URL-reference contract

outputs.validation: Bounded raw phase samples with environment identity, outcome and calculation method

canonical_state: The governed operation result, protocol frames and durable evidence remain authoritative
Performance samples are derived non-authoritative campaign artefacts
Timeouts retain their existing admission, startup, execution and cleanup owners
derived_state: Phase durations, percentiles, throughput and resource observations

authorities.grant: Execute only the fixed bounded workload on the qualified local operation
authorities.refusal: Reject unknown workloads, unsupported platforms, invalid bounds or output destinations

trust_boundaries.treatment: Decode strictly, enforce bounds and reject unknown fields or cases
Record observed outcomes without promoting worker output or timing data to trusted operation state

resources.bound: Existing operation process, memory, stream, startup, execution and cleanup limits
resources.cleanup_failure: Retain the operation cleanup failure and reject the sample as accepted performance evidence

resources.acquisition: One shared warm root plus one cold root per sample; each holds one attempt bundle at a time
resources.bound: One attempt bundle and 2097152 aggregate output bytes
resources.release: Inspect then remove the measured bundle before the next warm sample; remove the owned campaign directory after the profile
resources.cleanup_failure: Report the campaign failure and retain the path for operator inspection

platforms.evidence: Native qualified operation and performance campaign

invariants.statement: Instrumentation cannot change operation results, protocol bytes, evidence bytes, timeout ownership or cleanup
invariants.boundary: caller request to durable terminal attempt
invariants.falsifier: Instrumented and uninstrumented equivalent attempts differ outside identities and timestamps

assurance_controls.owner: independent operation model and artefact comparison

invariants.residual_uncertainty: Host scheduling and filesystem state remain measurement noise

invariants.statement: Every declared timing boundary is measured once by its current authority owner; durable publication includes final attempt-lock release
invariants.falsifier: A phase is missing, overlaps an unrelated authority boundary or is counted twice
invariants.residual_uncertainty: Concurrent stream and process phases overlap and are reported independently rather than summing to total latency

invariants.statement: Only gains beyond observed noise under equivalent workloads and semantics are accepted
invariants.falsifier: A claimed gain changes workload, cache state, durability, containment, verification, cleanup or hidden asynchronous work
invariants.residual_uncertainty: A single host cannot establish other-hardware budgets

success_semantics: Accepted means every required phase and resource metric was recorded for a valid bounded workload without semantic drift
refusal_semantics: Unknown, malformed, unsupported or out-of-bound workloads are rejected before operation execution
failure_semantics: Operation, persistence, cleanup, measurement or output failure remains explicit and cannot produce an accepted sample
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation retains the operation result and terminates campaign-owned work
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory phase, resource or outcome evidence cannot produce an accepted comparison
recovery_semantics: Raw samples are regenerated from the unchanged corpus; partial performance output is non-canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: Unused pre-release performance formats are replaced coherently with no compatibility reader
falsifiers: Instrumentation changes protocol or evidence bytes
A timing phase is omitted or double counted
A sample survives an operation or cleanup failure
A gain depends on a changed workload, weaker semantics or hidden work

assurance_controls.owner: independent operation model and artefact comparison

residual_limitations: Performance qualification is Windows AMD64 only
Hosted CI timing is not a native hardware benchmark
Concurrent phases do not form an additive total
Performance samples are not durable operation evidence
non_goals: Change operation, protocol, persistence, containment, authority or timeout semantics
Add a persistent worker, pool, daemon, service or broker
Preserve an unused pre-release performance format
deletion_criteria: Delete only when a reviewed later performance contract supersedes every reader, writer, corpus and report
